verdict.rationale: Nix's core model pins exact package versions/derivations via nix-shell, nix develop, and flakes, storing multiple versions in the Nix store so pins are respected per-project and reproducibly across machines; community testimony corroborates reliable dependency pinning in production use. missing for 10: explicit first-party documentation of flake.lock pinning workflow and independent hands-on verification of long-term pin stability across upgrades.
